product.name: Groene Point App
product.description: An app that enables users to report responsible waste disposal by taking photos and registering waste segregation activities to earn points redeemable for rewards.

product.name: Groene Point Moderation System
product.description: A system within the app allowing users to become moderators who review reports and earn additional points for their moderation activities.

product.name: Groene Point Rewards Integration
product.description: A feature that allows users to convert earned Groene Points into rewards through partner loyalty programs like Bounz Rewards.
